decision_rule: Battery R3/R4/R5 rules (fact-check-v-enclosures-battery-generator-R3-lines.json, -R5-lines-A.json), as applied in R6, R7-PA/PB and R7-SA: a line is corrected if any fact is not on a stated row of that plant (or a company row worded company-wide), is placed at the wrong site (shared-city rule), is misdated (board re-post stamp as a posting date; aggregator or expired copy written as live; a date the row does not carry), is a plan written as progress or a superseded figure, uses a live count of postings, leads with an older fact (opening lines; 'read <date>' clauses neutral), rests on a premise no row states (incl. a question presuming welding where no stated row shows it), lacks the closing 'you' question (opening lines), or the bottleneck guess is not hedged. Bottleneck guesses are corrected only when they state as fact something no row supports or place another site's fact at the plant. Leaving out a newer stated fact is not an error unless the line leads with an older dated fact (Marinette, Sturgeon Bay and St. Johns lead with a neutral read clause). A publication date must be on a cited row as the publication date (a hiring or production year in the value does not count: DIS-TRAN R7-PB, Tesla R5-B). A clause attached to more roles than its row carries is corrected (Derrick/Liebherr R6-B). A line clause that matches a stated row's value whose quote is short is confirmed and the row logged as field drift (SA Great Lakes precedent). 'listed <date>' for board stamps (Ashby publishedAt, Paylocity PublishedDate, UKG raw PostedDate, BAE Posted Date) allowed (coordinator rule 2026-11-17). Live = in the board's own list or JSON today, or the rendered page shows the role with Apply where a dead-ID control renders the closed message (GD/NASSCO, BAE). Unreachable = a clause rests only on a source that cannot be re-read today.
